C0704.title: UK Couple Sentenced for £9M Automated Ticket Scalping Fraud
C0704.summary: UK media reported that ticket touts Peter Hunter and David Smith bought large volumes of tickets for popular concerts and sporting events and resold them at high prices on secondary ticketing platforms. Public reporting states that their illegal ticket resale activity made about GBP 9 million and that they were ordered to repay GBP 6.1 million in criminal proceeds. The case illustrates how automated purchasing and bulk resale can harm ordinary consumers access to tickets.
